items.prompt: ___ the annual review has been criticised, it has not been replaced everywhere.
The system works ___ that managers are trained.
items.hintAfterError: Conector condicional formal: particípio do verbo + 'that' (= desde que).

items.prompt: ___ some companies use ratings, others have abandoned them.
items.hintAfterError: Contraste entre dois fatos em orações completas; 'Despite' pede substantivo, não oração.

items.prompt: ___ that evidence is mixed, a hybrid approach seems sensible.
The approach succeeds ___ or not a formal rating is retained.
items.hintAfterError: Só um desses conectores combina com 'or not' logo em seguida.
